summary.en: Browser Gomoku backed by an alpha-beta pruning AI, with several difficulty levels to pick from.
summary.zh: 网页五子棋 + Alpha-Beta 剪枝 AI，中文教程齐全。

description.en: Click the board to place stones, black and white alternating; first to five in a row in any direction wins. Multiple AI strength tiers are built in.
description.zh: 鼠标落子，黑白轮流，横竖斜任意方向先连成五子获胜；内置多档 AI 难度可选。

howto.en: Mouse — click a cross point to place your stone.

tip.en: One of the best-known web Gomoku projects in the Chinese community, with explainable AI moves and tunable difficulty. Add forbidden-move rules and it levels up into a standard competitive edition.
tip.zh: 中文社区最知名的网页五子棋之一，AI 走法可解释、可调难度。加个「先手禁手」规则就能升级成标准竞技版。
